g.text: UML Use Case Diagram: Level 2 – Subsystem 5.0 (Reporting, Analytics & Visual Dashboards)
Primitive Functional Decomposition aligned with DFD Level 2 (5.1 to 5.4)
Process 5.1: Compile Inventory Balances & Stock Valuation
Categorical Counts, FIFO/WAC Valuation & Shrinkage Detection
Dynamic Reorder Points, UI Warnings & Replenishment Requisitions
Formatted PDF Documents, Structured XLSX Workbooks & CSV Exports
Worker Task List, Executive KPI Dashboards & Interactive Charts
Auto-PO Dispatch to 6.2.1 and Agronomic API Weather Ingestion
